package.name: arxlift2s_ros2_control
package.description: ROS2 Control hardware interfaces for ARX LIFT2S: dual X5 arms via Stanford arx5-sdk (full_control MIX) and lift column via official LiftHeadControlLoop. Official InterfacesThread arm path is retired. Layout follows ht-ros2-control (external SDK) and modbus-style plugin XML.
